end of heading, Transformation is tough. We’ve built the pathways to ensure yours lands., level 2
Next-level healthcare. Built for the NHS.

Isla is a London-based health-tech company founded in 2019 by Peter Hansell and James Jurkiewicz. We provide a digital pathway platform designed to automate routine clinical tasks and streamline NHS workflows. Trusted by over 40 NHS Trusts, Isla focuses on increasing clinical capacity and empowering teams through media-led diagnostics and automated care pathways.
Built on clinical expertise and personal experience

Co-founders Peter Hansell and James Jurkiewicz launched Isla with deep backgrounds in healthcare transformation. Their mission was driven by personal experience navigating fragmented care for vulnerable family members. Seeing these system inefficiencies firsthand inspired them to replace manual hurdles with straightforward, automated solutions. Today, that same empathy fuels our goal: empowering clinical teams so that no patient or clinician is left struggling with a broken process.

Founded in London in 2019, Isla provides a digital pathway platform (DPP) designed to transform how clinical data moves through the NHS. By replacing fragmented care with connected, visible pathways, we help teams move faster and achieve more. We focus on automating routine admin, handling the heavy lifting so you can focus on complex decision-making. Our platform increases clinical capacity by streamlining workflows and freeing up valuable time for direct patient care.

In case you were wondering, we’re named after Pete’s Golden Retriever, Isla. As a former part of the Guide Dog training programme, Isla represents our commitment to helping others navigate complex paths with confidence. Just as a guide dog provides clarity and support, we’re here to be a trusted partner for clinical teams. We help you navigate the pressures of modern healthcare by providing the tools you need to stay focused on delivering great care.
Empowering clinicians to lead the future of care

We’re here to help the health system transition to a fundamentally better way of delivering care, one that is remote-first, efficient, and scalable. We know the pressure you’re under, which is why we’re dedicated to removing the manual hurdles that slow you down. Our goal is simple: to provide the tools and insights you need to make the best clinical decisions, freeing up your time for what matters most.
